*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/analyze_1.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+data = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        year(crash_date) AS year,
+        sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    params=[str(DATA)],
+).df()
+
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+bars = ax.bar(data["year"].astype(str), data["pedestrians_killed"], color="#176B87")
+ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.0f", padding=3, fontsize=8)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes\n"
+    "Annual sum of recorded pedestrian fatalities, by crash year",
+    fontsize=13,
+    pad=15,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year of crash")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.text(
+    0.5,
+    0.01,
+    "2013–2025; full calendar-year coverage. Counts reflect police-reported crash records and are not independently validated.",
+    ha="center",
+    fontsize=8,
+)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
*** End Patch

+++ /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E010/D-v2-plan4-AC-kfree-openai-gpt-6-luna-1119/K1-r3/out/analyze_1.py
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+data = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT
+        year(crash_date) AS year,
+        sum(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    params=[str(DATA)],
+).df()
+
+data.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+bars = ax.bar(data["year"].astype(str), data["pedestrians_killed"], color="#176B87")
+ax.bar_label(bars, fmt="%.0f", padding=3, fontsize=8)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed in police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes\n"
+    "Annual sum of recorded pedestrian fatalities, by crash year",
+    fontsize=13,
+    pad=15,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Calendar year of crash")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed (count)")
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.text(
+    0.5,
+    0.01,
+    "2013–2025; full calendar-year coverage. Counts reflect police-reported crash records and are not independently validated.",
+    ha="center",
+    fontsize=8,
+)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
